Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Draft for foundation review. This policy is not approved for public use.

01 / Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Siliguri Aashray Welfare Foundation respects the privacy of people who contact us, volunteer or express interest in supporting our work. This policy explains how information submitted through our website is intended to be used.

02 / Privacy Policy

Information we collect

When you use our enquiry forms, we collect the details you choose to provide, such as your name, contact information, location, interests, availability, skills and message. Volunteer forms may also ask your age to help assess participation suitability.

Please do not submit medical records, identification documents, financial account details or other sensitive information through general enquiry forms.

03 / Privacy Policy

How we use your information

We use enquiry information to respond to you, review volunteer or partnership interests, discuss support arrangements and maintain appropriate records of those interactions. We do not automatically enrol enquiry submitters into promotional mailing lists.

Preview · confirmation needed[Confirm any additional approved uses, such as program registration, event coordination or donor administration, before adding them.]

04 / Privacy Policy

Access and service providers

Information is intended to be accessible to authorised people who need it to respond to or manage your enquiry. Website hosting, form and communication providers may process data as part of delivering those services.

Donations and payments

If online payments are introduced, this policy will identify the approved payment provider and explain the donor information retained for payment records and receipts. Payment credentials should be processed by the approved provider rather than submitted in a general enquiry form.

07 / Privacy Policy

Photographs and stories

Photographs, videos and personal stories will be reviewed before publication. The foundation will seek appropriate permission for identifiable personal stories and images, with additional care for children and vulnerable individuals. Contact us if you wish to raise a concern about material published on this website.

08 / Privacy Policy

Retention and security

We intend to retain information only for the period needed for the purpose for which it was collected and any applicable recordkeeping requirements. Access controls and suitable security measures should protect the records we maintain.

Your requests

You may contact us to ask about information you have submitted, request a correction or raise a privacy concern. We will review requests according to the circumstances and applicable requirements.
